verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents connecting voice agents to phone networks for inbound and outbound calls, but only via a bridge such as Twilio streaming audio to your own server. There is no evidence of any campaign layer, so batching, scheduling and throughput control would have to be built yourself on top of the telephony provider. Missing for 10: batch campaign management, call scheduling, concurrency/throughput controls, any outbound-campaign docs or hands-on corroboration.
